My name is Magdalena Urrutia but everyone calls me Mane, I joined the CCJW on January of 2022. I am from Chile and my dreams are related to travel the world and visit new places. I also would love to learn another language (maybe french or german). I would also like to develop a career in the research field. My main achievement has been to enter to Universidad de Chile and to approve all my classes because it has been a hard road but I worked very hard and I am persistent. Another important achievement for me has been to join the ELAP program. In my spare time i like to travel with my father to beautiful places around the world, I also like listening to music while I go jogging. I also love to spend time with my little cousings because they brighten up my day.

## Project

My thesis is related to friction stir welding for aerospace applications, it is very important beacause this kind of welding allows to weld materials that are difficult to weld like Aluminium for example which is used to build parts of rockets and planes
